'''Trailblaze''' is an [[enchantment]] added by [[Matcha Flavoured]] for boots, meant to make the wearer faster on paths, gravel and mud bricks. Its internal name is ''Traversal''.

== Obtaining ==
* [[Prayer of St. Clement]], a crafted [[blessing]] (Trailblaze III). It stores <code>matcha:traversal</code> directly, so applying it to boots that already have Trailblaze does not go past level III.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/blessing/traversal.json}}</ref>
* The Prayer of Exodus [[Ofuda]], traded from the [[Mouthpiece]] for [[The Tanakh]] (Trailblaze III, with Loyalty III and Power II).
* [[Sturdy Leather Boots]] are crafted with Trailblaze I, and those found in chests have it too.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/sturdy_leather_boots.json}}</ref>

== Behavior ==
=== Speed ===
While the wearer is on a path block, the enchantment adds 0.0155 movement speed per level (to the base player speed of 0.1), so Trailblaze III makes them about 46% faster. The boost stays while the wearer is in the air after leaving a path block, and does not apply while riding or flying.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/enchantment/traversal.json}}</ref>

The path blocks are the pack's <code>#matcha:is_path</code> tag:<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/tags/block/is_path.json}}</ref>
* {{MCW|Dirt Path|dirt path}} and {{MCW|Coarse Dirt|coarse dirt}}
* {{MCW|Gravel|gravel}}
* {{MCW|Packed Mud|packed mud}}
* {{MCW|Mud Bricks|mud bricks}}, mud brick slabs and mud brick stairs
* [[Dirt Slab]]s

=== Durability and particles ===
Each time the wearer moves while on the ground on a path block, the boots have a 4% chance per level to lose 1 durability. Walking on a path block kicks up dirt particles every 5 ticks.

Trailblaze's anvil cost multiplier is 0, and its enchanting table cost is 1 plus 1 per level above the first.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/enchantment/traversal.json}}</ref>

=== 26.3 port ===
{{Upcoming|the 26.3 port}}
In the 1.12.3 alpha for ''Minecraft'' 26.3, and on the repository's 26.3 branch, the enchantment has no speed attribute. While the wearer is on a path block (or still on the ground after leaving one), it only runs a function that sets the wearer's <code>traversal</code> score to 1, and a timer resets that score to 0 every 2 seconds. Nothing reads the score, so the boots do not speed the wearer up.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/enchantment/traversal.json|at=c8c13d7c0f57052846353ba8b0986896e9c95c4c}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/enchantment_effects/traversal.mcfunction|at=c8c13d7c0f57052846353ba8b0986896e9c95c4c}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/timers/2s/traversal.mcfunction|at=c8c13d7c0f57052846353ba8b0986896e9c95c4c}}</ref> Its anvil cost multiplier there is 8 and its enchanting table cost 10 plus 10 per level above the first. Its description is the vanilla key <code>enchantment.minecraft.soul_speed</code>, so boots show "Soul Speed" instead of "Trailblaze"; the developer's commit that changed it says it was edited to get the enchantment running on 26.3.

== Issues ==
* The developer's notes for earlier versions record that the speed boost from mud brick slabs applied after a jump but not when running normally.<ref>{{Cite changelog|quote=When running on mud brick slabs with traversal boots, when I jump I get the speed boost, but when I just run on it normally I don't get the speed boost}}</ref>
